description:
Title: Contract

For your contract project you need parts from several web shops.
In order to find out which web shop has the right parts, you have to query them all, and find out how much they can deliver, at which price, and how long it will take.
Create a list of parts that you order from each shop.
If one shop has not enough  parts, order from several shops.
Always use the cheapest parts.
The parts arrive in batches in a random order, typically they are +/- 2 days earlier/later.
When the first parts arrive you start building.
Sometimes you have to reorder parts.
If your stock (for a single part) falls below 5, you reorder (the cheapest), if it falls below 3 you reorder again (the fastest).
If it is zero, you write a mail to your friends, complaining about the webshops.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/contract">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_QuoteRequest" name="Quote request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Quote" name="Quantities, prices and delivery times"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Parts order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Parts" name="Parts batch"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Complaint" name="Complaint email"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Contract">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Contract" name="Contract project" processRef="Process_Contract"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Shops" name="Web shops"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_QuoteRequest" name="Query all web shops" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Participant_Shops" messageRef="Message_QuoteRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Quote" name="Shop responses" sourceRef="Participant_Shops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveQuotes" messageRef="Message_Quote"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InitialOrder" name="Parts order" sourceRef="Task_SendInitialOrders" targetRef="Participant_Shops" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FirstBatch" name="First parts batch" sourceRef="Participant_Shops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch" messageRef="Message_Parts"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CheapReorder" name="Cheapest parts reorder" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Participant_Shops" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FastReorder" name="Fastest parts reorder" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Participant_Shops" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Complaint" name="Complaint email" sourceRef="Task_EmailFriends" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Contract" name="Contract" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ContractProject" name="Contract project starts"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_QueryShops" name="Query all web shops"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveQuotes" name="Receive quantities, prices and delivery times"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectCheapest" name="Select the cheapest parts"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SufficientOneShop" name="Can one shop supply enough?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AllocateSeveralShops" name="Allocate parts across several shops"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeShopAllocation" name="Continue with shop allocation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateLists" name="Create a parts order list for each shop"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendInitialOrders" name="Send parts orders"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch" name="Receive first parts batch (random order; typically ±2 days)"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildProject" name="Start building the contract project"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckStock" name="Check stock for a single part"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockThresholds" name="Apply stock thresholds" default="Flow_StockDefault"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder the cheapest parts"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder the fastest parts"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EmailFriends" name="Email friends to complain about the web shops"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockActionsJoin" name="Stock actions complete"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_StockHandled" name="Stock response handled"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Query" sourceRef="Start_ContractProject" targetRef="Task_QueryShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Query_Quotes" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveQuotes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Quotes_Select" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveQuotes" targetRef="Task_SelectCheapest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_Sufficient" sourceRef="Task_SelectCheapest" targetRef="Gateway_SufficientOneShop"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sufficient_Lists" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_SufficientOneShop" targetRef="Gateway_MergeShopAllocation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotSufficient_Allocate" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_SufficientOneShop" targetRef="Task_AllocateSeveralShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Allocate_Merge" sourceRef="Task_AllocateSeveralShops" targetRef="Gateway_MergeShopAllocation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Lists" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeShopAllocation" targetRef="Task_CreateLists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Lists_Send" sourceRef="Task_CreateLists" targetRef="Task_SendInitialOrders"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Send_FirstBatch" sourceRef="Task_SendInitialOrders" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FirstBatch_Build" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch" targetRef="Task_BuildProject"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Build_Check" sourceRef="Task_BuildProject" targetRef="Task_CheckStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_Thresholds" sourceRef="Task_CheckStock" targetRef="Gateway_StockThresholds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockBelow5" sourceRef="Gateway_StockThresholds" targetRef="Task_ReorderCheapest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock < 5</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockBelow3" sourceRef="Gateway_StockThresholds" targetRef="Task_ReorderFastest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock < 3</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockZero" sourceRef="Gateway_StockThresholds" targetRef="Task_EmailFriends">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stock = 0</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockDefault" sourceRef="Gateway_StockThresholds" targetRef="Gateway_StockActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheapReorder_Join" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Gateway_StockActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FastReorder_Join" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Gateway_StockActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Email_Join" sourceRef="Task_EmailFriends" targetRef="Gateway_StockActionsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_End" sourceRef="Gateway_StockActionsJoin" targetRef="End_StockHandled"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
